fields.title: Gakkō Shisetsu Chōhatsu ni Kansuru Shū Chōkan Tsūchi

notice.subject: Gunji un'yō oyobi kunren ni tomonau gakkō kōsha no chōhatsu
notice.reason: Bōei kōbutsu o shien suru tame no kōkyō oyobi kyōiku shisetsu no kinkyū gyōsei saihaichi.

fields.content: Kono tsūchi ni yori, Balikpapan Kokumin Gakkō no kyōshitsu oyobi shisetsu wa gunji kōmu no tame ni chōhatsu sareru koto o tōchi saremasu. Kyōin oyobi seito wa shitei sareta daitai basho e idō suru koto ga motomeraremasu.

claims.fact: Pemberitahuan resmi militer memerintahkan pengambilalihan fasilitas sekolah untuk keperluan pertahanan dan logistik perang.
